calls.title: Sync on Marketing Brand Presence
calls.summary: The team discussed the necessity for a consistent brand voice and design to improve market presence, agreeing to explore external branding support. Key discussions included defining voice, tone, and humor in marketing, while avoiding full rebranding. Kari Kay shared foundational brand archetypes to guide differentiation, emphasizing visuals and audience perception. The evolving use of gradients for design was clarified to maintain legibility, and humor's role was debated to ensure alignment with the brand's sophisticated image. The mascot named 'Bandit' was proposed, with a focus on integrating humor thoughtfully across channels. The group recognized the importance of external expert help for cohesive branding while planning to develop content internally to maintain momentum.
calls.keywords: branding, humor strategy, mascot, brand voice, visual identity, marketing consistency
